rows.text: “Our first quarter results demonstrate the continued momentum in our business, with robust exabyte growth and improved pricing driving another quarter of strong financial performance,” said Kris Sennesael, CFO of WD. “Looking ahead, for our fiscal second quarter of 2027, at the midpoint of the ranges, we expect revenue of $5.1 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 60.5%, and non-GAAP EPS of $5.80.”
